summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Sharon Johnston, a native of Sault Ste. Marie. It describes her academic path, covering physiotherapy and occupational therapy training at the University of Toronto, a BSc from the University of Western Ontario, an MSc from McGill University, and a PhD in rehabilitation science from McGill.
one_line: Sharon Johnston is a Sault Ste. Marie native with degrees in physiotherapy, occupational therapy, and rehabilitation science from Toronto, Western Ontario, and McGill.
key_facts: Sharon Johnston is a native of Sault Ste. Marie.
Sharon Johnston completed studies in physiotherapy and occupational therapy at the University of Toronto.
Sharon Johnston received a BSc degree at the University of Western Ontario.
Sharon Johnston received an MSc degree at McGill University.
Sharon Johnston graduated as a Doctor of Philosophy in rehabilitation science at McGill University.
